author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

reshared_post.reshared_text:
Queen of Chips, Lisa Su 🤝 Godmother of AI, Fei-Fei Li

A picture is worth a thousand words and we're so excited to make it official as we formally close the acquisition and welcome the World Labs team to AMD!

World Labs brings a world-class AI research team and deep model expertise to AMD, strengthening our capabilities across the AI stack. Led by Dr. Fei-Fei Li, who joins AMD as EVP and chief scientist, the team will advance AI model research and bring insights into emerging workloads directly into the development of future AMD hardware, software and systems.

Together, we'll help shape the next generation of open AI infrastructure and better support the customers and developers building tomorrow's AI models and applications!
